verdict.rationale: Docs show official SDK usage patterns (client.graph.edge.delete, thread.add_messages, thread.get_user_context) and a quick-start guide claiming integration in 'three lines of code', plus framework-specific integrations (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.) that build on the SDK. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported languages/SDKs (e.g., TS, Go), and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
